output.reason: The brief ties the timing of the drop to the Finance credit-limit change, gives a plausible size for the effect (referrals went from 7% to 54% and referred calls resolve far less often) and shows that new and tenured agents look the same, which fits the agent comment about bills going to BRT; I'm slightly less confident because the IVR change wasn't tested separately and we can't see the underlying data.
